meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划拆给多个子代理并行执行,并留下执行证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有一份写好的工作计划,想让它被自动跑完
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan across parallel subagents and keep an evidence log
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you already have a written plan and want it executed for you

howto.what: Claude 只做编排,不自己写代码或改产品文件。它读取 .omo/plans 下的计划,把实现、测试、评审派给并行子代理,维护 Boulder 状态和证据账本,直到计划勾选框全部完成。
howto.when: 当你说 ulw-execute,或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划时触发;若没有可选计划而你说 start work,它会先调用 ulw-plan 生成计划再执行。

say.note: 先建 Boulder 状态,再逐项派活
每个阶段推分支并开 PR
PR 跟到合并,之后清理 worktree

howto.what_en: Claude is an orchestrator: it never writes code or edits product files. It reads a written plan, delegates implementation, tests and review to parallel subagents, and keeps Boulder state and an evidence ledger until every checkbox is done.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say ulw-execute or ask to run a .omo/plans plan. With no selectable plan and a clear 'start work', it first bootstraps ulw-plan to create one.

say_en.note: Sets Boulder state, then dispatches each checkbox
Each phase opens its own PR
Follows the PR to merge, then removes the worktree
